additional_info.subject: ID0440231-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S0 170004177]Charging issue CRM:00315002868
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues, this charger is not able to charge in DC4 due to missing in voltage in CableCheck. We can see that the converter group has 500V so it must be one of the following: QA23-24, QA241-242 or TF204.
Be sure to follow all the safety procedures, use a crocodile tip to measure here during a charging session:
If we have voltage here, then that means QA23-24 is good.
if we don't have voltage, that means we need to replace QA23-24 as it's not closing properly.
If we have voltage in the busbar, we need to check if the voltage transducer is reading the values properly here, it must align with the value you see on SCB logs "Reading: [X]V":
If the transducer is not the problem, we can make sure it's the QA241-242 by measuring in the busbar right before the input of TF204.
Please take spare contactors and TF204 on-site.
